tiebreakers.description: Most Action Points (Clan Marker on AP track after returning Guards at game end)
If still tied, victory is shared.

endCondition.description: Ends after the round in which a player places the 5th City Base, the last Building, or a City becomes the 2nd Capital.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Final scoring adds Strength x Quest products for the topmost tile of each pair (Bracelet x Lamp, Coin x Chest, Sword x Mask) to the track VP; the numbers are the printed values on the topmost tiles of each stack (enter those two numbers). Expert mandate cards (E-deck) add end bonuses; D-deck bonuses are gained during play and are on the track. City cards not modelled. AP tiebreaker value is entered by the table, not in this template.
